{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace BucketAgg

inductive FillMode where
  | none
  | previous

inductive EventValue where
  | null
  | val (n : Nat)

structure Event where
  group : String
  time : Nat
  value : EventValue

structure Input where
  events : List Event
  start : Nat
  end : Nat
  width : Nat
  fill : FillMode

structure BucketResult where
  group : String
  start : Nat
  count : Nat
  value : EventValue

def valid (inp : Input) : Prop :=
  inp.start ≤ inp.end ∧ inp.width > 0

def inRange (inp : Input) (t : Nat) : Bool :=
  t ≥ inp.start ∧ t < inp.end

def bucketIndex (inp : Input) (t : Nat) : Nat :=
  (t - inp.start) / inp.width

def bucketStart (inp : Input) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  inp.start + i * inp.width

def numBuckets (inp : Input) : Nat :=
  (inp.end - inp.start + inp.width - 1) / inp.width

def countInBucket (inp : Input) (g : String) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  List.length (List.filter (fun e => e.group = g ∧ inRange inp e.time ∧ bucketIndex inp e.time = i ∧ e.value ≠ EventValue.null) inp.events)

def sumInBucket (inp : Input) (g : String) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  List.sum (List.map (fun e => match e.value with | EventValue.val n => n | EventValue.null => 0) (List.filter (fun e => e.group = g ∧ inRange inp e.time ∧ bucketIndex inp e.time = i ∧ e.value ≠ EventValue.null) inp.events))

def solve (inp : Input) : List BucketResult :=
  let groups := List.distinct (List.map (fun e => e.group) inp.events)
  let sortedGroups := List.sort groups
  let nb := numBuckets inp
  let mkBucket (g : String) (i : Nat) : BucketResult :=
    let c := countInBucket inp g i
    let s := sumInBucket inp g i
    let v : EventValue :=
      if c > 0 then EventValue.val s
      else if inp.fill = FillMode.none then EventValue.null
      else
        let prev := List.findMap? (fun j => if j < i ∧ countInBucket inp g j > 0 then some (sumInBucket inp g j) else none) (List.range i)
        match prev with
        | some s => EventValue.val s
        | none => EventValue.null
    { group := g, start := bucketStart inp i, count := c, value := v }
  List.flatten (List.map (fun g => List.map (fun i => mkBucket g i) (List.range nb)) sortedGroups)

theorem thm_O1 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  (List.map (fun r => r.group) (solve inp)) = List.map (fun g => g) (List.sort (List.distinct (List.map (fun e => e.group) inp.events))) := by sorry

theorem thm_O2 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  ∀ (r : BucketResult), r ∈ solve inp → r.start ≥ inp.start ∧ r.start < inp.end ∧ (r.start - inp.start) % inp.width = 0 := by sorry

theorem thm_O3 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  ∀ (e : Event), e ∈ inp.events → inRange inp e.time → ∃ (r : BucketResult), r ∈ solve inp ∧ r.group = e.group ∧ r.start ≤ e.time ∧ e.time < r.start + inp.width := by sorry

theorem thm_O4 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  ∀ (g : String) (i : Nat), i < numBuckets inp → (List.filter (fun r => r.group = g ∧ r.start = bucketStart inp i) (solve inp)).getD! 0.count = countInBucket inp g i := by sorry

theorem thm_O5 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  ∀ (g : String) (i : Nat), i < numBuckets inp → countInBucket inp g i > 0 → (List.filter (fun r => r.group = g ∧ r.start = bucketStart inp i) (solve inp)).getD! 0.value = EventValue.val (sumInBucket inp g i) := by sorry

theorem thm_O6 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) (hf : inp.fill = FillMode.none) :
  ∀ (g : String) (i : Nat), i < numBuckets inp → countInBucket inp g i = 0 → (List.filter (fun r => r.group = g ∧ r.start = bucketStart inp i) (solve inp)).getD! 0.value = EventValue.null := by sorry

theorem thm_O7 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) (hf : inp.fill = FillMode.previous) :
  ∀ (g : String) (i : Nat), i < numBuckets inp → countInBucket inp g i = 0 →
    (List.filter (fun r => r.group = g ∧ r.start = bucketStart inp i) (solve inp)).getD! 0.value =
      match List.findMap? (fun j => if j < i ∧ countInBucket inp g j > 0 then some (sumInBucket inp g j) else none) (List.range i) with
      | some s => EventValue.val s
      | none => EventValue.null := by sorry

theorem thm_O8 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) (hf : inp.fill = FillMode.previous) :
  ∀ (g : String) (i : Nat), i < numBuckets inp → countInBucket inp g i = 0 →
    (List.filter (fun r => r.group = g ∧ r.start = bucketStart inp i) (solve inp)).getD! 0.value =
      match List.findMap? (fun j => if j < i ∧ countInBucket inp g j > 0 then some (sumInBucket inp g j) else none) (List.range i) with
      | some s => EventValue.val s
      | none => EventValue.null := by sorry

theorem thm_O9 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  ∀ (e : Event), e ∈ inp.events → e.time < inp.start → ¬ (∃ (r : BucketResult), r ∈ solve inp ∧ r.group = e.group ∧ r.start ≤ e.time) := by sorry

theorem thm_O10 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  List.map (fun r => (r.group, r.start)) (solve inp) = List.map (fun r => (r.group, r.start)) (List.sort (List.map (fun r => (r.group, r.start)) (solve inp))) := by sorry

theorem thm_O11 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) (hf : inp.fill = FillMode.previous) :
  ∀ (g : String) (i : Nat), i < numBuckets inp → countInBucket inp g i > 0 → sumInBucket inp g i = 0 →
    ∀ (j : Nat), j < numBuckets inp → i < j → countInBucket inp g j = 0 →
      (List.filter (fun r => r.group = g ∧ r.start = bucketStart inp j) (solve inp)).getD! 0.value = EventValue.val 0 := by sorry

theorem thm_O12 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  ∀ (g : String) (i : Nat), i < numBuckets inp → countInBucket inp g i = (List.filter (fun e => e.group = g ∧ inRange inp e.time ∧ bucketIndex inp e.time = i ∧ e.value ≠ EventValue.null) inp.events).length := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (inp : Input), valid inp ∧ solve inp ≠ [] ∧ ∃ (inp2 : Input), valid inp2 ∧ solve inp2 = [] := by sorry

end BucketAgg",
